scope: Theorem 6.4 (Unrestricted thermal law) of the manuscript “Renewal and changes of law for critical honeycomb walks” (preprints/Renewal-and-changes-of-law-for-critical-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d179fa55e4b82fed), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Choose an ordinary plane honeycomb walk from a fixed vertex with probability proportional to (ρe−1/N )n, where n is its edge length. For every ξ > 0, its vertex length L, endpoint distance A and diameter D satisfy PN {N1−ξ ≤ L ≤ N1+ξ , N3/4−ξ ≤ A ≤ D ≤ N3/4+ξ } −→ 1. For every fixed p > 0, EN Lp = Np+o(1) , EN Ap = N3p/4+o(1) , EN Dp = N3p/4+o(1) .
